say:0:1310903001:0.text: How come there are Hypofiends here?

say:0:1310904001:0.text: May Dura bless us. I hope nothing has happened at St. Valesa's Temple...
say:0:1310904001:0.source_cn: 艾雅保佑，希望圣瓦勒沙教堂不要出事……

say:0:1310908001:0.text: The temple is located on the highest cliff to the north. I guess I have to go climbing again.
say:0:1310908001:0.source_cn: 修道院建在在北边最高的山崖之上……呼，又得爬山了。

say:0:1310910001:0.source_cn: 呼……呼……还有、还有一点就……到了……

say:1:1310910002:0.text: You look tired. Why don't we take a break?
say:1:1310910002:0.source_cn: 你真的累坏了，还是在这里休息一会吧！

say:2:1310910003:0.text: I'll find some regenerative herbs for him.
say:2:1310910003:0.source_cn: 我去找一些提神的草药给他，很管用的！

say:1:1310911001:1.text: *Sigh*... I feel much better now. Thank you for the herbs. They were helpful.
say:1:1310911001:1.source_cn: 呼……我好多了，谢谢你们的草药，很管用。

say:2:1310911002:1.text: You seem to really trust and respect the Hierophant.
say:2:1310911002:1.source_cn: 你好像很信任、很尊敬大主教？

say:3:1310911003:1.text: Of course, Hierophant Novik is the wisest and kindest man I've ever met.
say:3:1310911003:1.source_cn: 正是。诺维茨基大主教阁下是我见过最圣洁、最虔诚、最和蔼...

say:4:1310911004:1.text: Since the founding of Whiteridge Temple, he has been its most illustrious leader and one of the hierophants most favored by the Divinum Centrum.
say:4:1310911004:1.source_cn: 他是白山修道院建立以来最为出色的院长，也是最受圣座宠信...

say:5:1310911005:1.text: It's said that more than a thousand years ago, the goddess sent down a divine message asking the people to find a holy place to build a temple to guide those of the faith.
say:5:1310911005:1.source_cn: 据说一千多年前女神曾降下神谕，要寻找一个圣洁之所，建起...

choice_prompt:6:1310911005.text: It's said that more than a thousand years ago, the goddess sent down a divine message asking the people to find a holy place to build a temple to guide those of the faith.
choice_prompt:6:1310911005.source_cn: 据说一千多年前女神曾降下神谕，要寻找一个圣洁之所，建起祂的修道院，以此指引那些虔诚的信徒。

say:7:1310911006:1.text: That's right! This is one of the oldest temples in the Lightbearer Empire!
say:7:1310911006:1.source_cn: 没错！这里是整个耀光帝国里最古老的修道院之一！
say:7:1310911006:1.male: That's right! This is one of the oldest temples in the Lightbearer Empire!
say:7:1310911006:1.female: That's right! This is one of the oldest temples in the Lightbearer Empire!

say:8:1310911008:1.text: The people here have always believed devoutly in Dura since ancient times.
say:8:1310911008:1.source_cn: 你们知道，这里的人们从古至今，一直虔诚地信仰这位伟大的女神。

say:9:1310911009:1.text: Without the blessing of the goddess, the people wouldn't have been able to defeat the Hypogeans. The land would not be what it is like today.
say:9:1310911009:1.source_cn: 如果没有女神的赐福，人们根本无法战胜恶魔，也就不会有现...

say:10:1310911010:1.text: Indeed. Without her, overcoming the Hypogeans is an impossibility.
say:10:1310911010:1.source_cn: 没有祂就无法战胜恶魔……呵，你说得对。

say:11:1310911011:1.text: The strength of so-called "heroes" and mortal beings is naught compared to the powers of a god.
say:11:1310911011:1.source_cn: 所谓“英雄”与凡人的力量，与神明相比毫无意义。

say:13:1310911012:1.text: What did you just say, Valka?
say:13:1310911012:1.source_cn: 瓦丽卡，你刚才说了什么？

say:14:1310911013:1.text: It's of no import... Let us depart for the temple.
say:14:1310911013:1.source_cn: 不，没什么……我们该出发去大修道院了。

say:15:1310911014:1.text: Wait a moment. I apologize, Lady Valka, but you may need a cloak. I'm not saying that a Graveborn cannot enter the temple. It's just... less complicated this way.
say:15:1310911014:1.source_cn: 请等等，抱歉，瓦丽卡女士，或许你需要一件斗篷……呃，我...

say:18:1310911007:0.text: According to historical records, the goddess sent an emissary to convey her message, but the book did not record the name of the messenger.
say:18:1310911007:0.source_cn: 据典籍记载，女神派遣祂的神使前来传谕，不过书中没有记录...
say:18:1310911007:0.male: According to historical records, the goddess sent an emissary to convey her message, but the book did not record the name of the messenger.
say:18:1310911007:0.female: According to historical records, the goddess sent an emissary to convey her message, but the book did not record the name of the messenger.

say:1:1310912001:1.text: Whiteridge Temple... We're finally here. Anyone would be moved by the grandeur and piety of this place.
say:1:1310912001:1.source_cn: 啊，总算到了，白山修道院……艾雅在上，任何人都会被这里...

say:2:1310912002:1.text: It's so quiet here. There are no guards anywhere. No one's even talking.
say:2:1310912002:1.source_cn: 这里好安静啊，没有守门人，连说话的声音都没有！

say:3:1310912003:1.text: Because this is a sacred place for contemplation. Look, that's the statue of Saint Callahan, the patron saint of Whiteridge and the first caretaker of this temple.
say:3:1310912003:1.source_cn: 因为这是静心沉思的神圣场所。看，这是圣杨凯维奇的雕像，...

say:4:1310912004:1.text: My parents named me after him, hoping that I would become a man of virtue like him.
say:4:1310912004:1.source_cn: 我的父母为我起了和他一样的名字，正是希望我也能成为和他...

say:5:1310912005:1.text: We should survey the area in case anything is amiss.
say:5:1310912005:1.source_cn: 为了防备意外，我们应该先四处看看。

say:6:1310912006:1.text: How can anything be amiss here?
say:6:1310912006:1.source_cn: 意外？不不，这里怎么可能有意外。

choice_prompt:7:1310912006.text: How can anything be amiss here?
choice_prompt:7:1310912006.source_cn: 意外？不不，这里怎么可能有意外。

say:8:1310912007:1.text: Oh, yes, that's right! Words from the goddess' teachings!
say:8:1310912007:1.source_cn: 噢，你说得对！这是圣典中的话语，是女神的教导。
say:8:1310912007:1.male: Oh, yes, that's right! Words from the goddess' teachings!
say:8:1310912007:1.female: Oh, yes, that's right! Words from the goddess' teachings!

say:9:1310912012:1.text: ... Alright, please follow me. I'll show you around.
say:9:1310912012:1.source_cn: ……好吧，请跟我来，我带你们四处看看。

say:11:1310912008:1.text: No, this holy place is the Hierophant's own residence! No one can desecrate this sacred temple!
say:11:1310912008:1.source_cn: 不，这里是大主教阁下的圣所！没人可以亵渎这座神圣的修道院！
say:11:1310912008:1.male: No, this holy place is the Hierophant's own residence! No one can desecrate this sacred temple!
say:11:1310912008:1.female: No, this holy place is the Hierophant's own residence! No one can desecrate this sacred temple!

say:13:1310912009:1.text: But the two temples before were corrupted. You saw it with your own eyes. We must be careful.
say:13:1310912009:1.source_cn: 可之前那两个教堂都出事了，这是你亲眼所见，我们必须得谨慎。

say:14:1310912010:1.text: Dura above, the goddess would never stand by and let her chosen sanctuary be defiled by evil.
say:14:1310912010:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上，女神绝不会坐视自己钦选的圣所被邪恶占据的！

choice:7:1:2.source_cn: 或许邪恶也蔓延到了这里

say:1:1310913001:1.text: This is the Saints' Gallery where we'd often discuss the ancient texts... but there's no one here today.
say:1:1310913001:1.source_cn: 这里是“圣徒长廊”，我们常在此处讨论经典……呃，不过今...

say:2:1310913002:1.text: I know many brothers and sisters leave on the temple's business, and the rest may be out in the backyard working.
say:2:1310913002:1.source_cn: 或许是大家日常都在后院修习，还有一些兄弟姐妹们外出办事。

say:3:1310913003:1.text: Maybe we are worrying too much... It looks normal here. Just not as many people as Chippy imagined.
say:3:1310913003:1.source_cn: 可能真是我们多虑了……唔，这里看起来很正常嘛，就是人少了点。

say:1:1310914001:1.text: Hey, whose diary is this? A few pages fell out...
say:1:1310914001:1.source_cn: 咦，这是哪位修士的笔记？怎么会有几页掉在这里……

say:2:1310914002:1.text: Ah, probably from one of my careless brethren.

say:3:1310914003:1.text:
"Up at 4:30. Morning prayers at 5..."
Wow, it must be hard to be an acolyte. Saying goodbye to your comfortable bed so early in the morning... Chippy would cry.
say:3:1310914003:1.source_cn: “早上四点三十分起床，五点晨祷……”\n哇，修士可真辛...

say:4:1310914004:1.text:
"The turnip soup was too salty. The boiled beans were too bland..."
It seems the meals here are very uninspiring.
say:4:1310914004:1.source_cn: “芜菁浓汤过咸，煮豆子又太淡……”\n看来修道院的人吃...

say:5:1310914005:1.text: "... The Hierophant plans to appoint two new priests to the temple... I can finally meet His Excellency..."
say:5:1310914005:1.source_cn: “……大主教阁下将在小礼拜堂内任命两位新的领区主教……...

say:6:1310914006:1.text: Bless Dura above. This brother is as faithful as I am.
say:6:1310914006:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上，这位兄弟与我一样虔诚忠实。

say:1:1310915001:1.text: It's so quiet out here. Not even a voice can be heard...
say:1:1310915001:1.source_cn: 修道院里如此安静，连说话声都没有……

say:3:1310915003:1.text: Not really… perhaps everyone is praying in the temple?
say:3:1310915003:1.source_cn: 并不……可能兄弟姐妹们正在大教堂内祈祷？

say:4:1310915004:2.text: We can look inside the temple from the windows!
say:4:1310915004:2.source_cn: 我们可以从窗户向大教堂里面看看！

say:6:1310915005:1.text: It's hard to see through the stained glass windows, but I do see figures inside.
say:6:1310915005:1.source_cn: 彩窗玻璃很暗……好像里面有人影，但看不清。

say:7:1310915006:1.text: Maybe there's a special event going on... I'll ask someone later.
say:7:1310915006:1.source_cn: 或许最近有什么特别活动……嗯，等等去找人问问。

say:0:1310915101:0.text: Strange... There's no one here... Forget it. Let's go to the temple and pay our respects to the Hierophant.
say:0:1310915101:0.source_cn: 奇怪，没人……算了，我们还是去大教堂里拜见大主教阁下吧！

say:0:1310916001:0.text: Halt. The temple is temporarily closed to the public.
say:0:1310916001:0.source_cn: 各位，请止步，大教堂暂时不对外开放。

say:1:1310917001:1.text: How come you're here, Brother Callahan? Aren't you supposed to be at St. Kinga's Temple?
say:1:1310917001:1.source_cn: 噢，杨凯维奇兄弟，你怎么突然到访？你不是应该回圣金嘉教堂吗？

say:2:1310917002:1.text: That's the reason why I'm here. Something's happened. We have urgent matters to tell the Hierophant.
say:2:1310917002:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上，圣金嘉教堂出事了，我正是因为此事而来的！我和...

say:3:1310917003:1.text: His Excellency hasn't been in great health lately... Therefore, we have suspended all religious activities to allow the Hierophant to rest and heal in peace.
say:3:1310917003:1.source_cn: 大主教阁下身体状态……不太好。正因如此，我们最近暂停了...

say:4:1310917004:1.text: No wonder there's no one here. Can we meet His Excellency? Our magister is a great mage who knows a lot of healing magic.
say:4:1310917004:1.source_cn: 怪不得都没有人呢，那我们能见见大主教阁下吗？我的主人是...
say:4:1310917004:1.male: No wonder there's no one here. Can we meet His Excellency? Our magister is a great mage who knows a lot of healing magic.
say:4:1310917004:1.female: No wonder there's no one here. Can we meet His Excellency? Our magister is a great mage who knows a lot of healing magic.

say:5:1310917005:1.text: ... We have acolytes who are skilled at healing. The Hierophant does not want his illness to spread to others, and he needs peace and quiet to recuperate.
say:5:1310917005:1.source_cn: ……我们有擅长治疗的修士，大主教阁下不希望他的病传染给...

say:6:1310917006:1.text: But something bad has happened! Cultists were performing Hypogean rituals in the other temples. There's also a time loop in Cedartown.
say:6:1310917006:1.source_cn: 可是这里出了大事！有邪教徒在教堂里进行恶魔崇拜的仪式，...

say:7:1310917007:1.text: Everything's gone nuts! We need to see the Hierophant and let him know what's going on!
say:7:1310917007:1.source_cn: 这些情况太不正常了，我们需要见大主教，得让他知道这一切！

say:8:1310917008:1.text: Hypogean rituals? Time loops? What are you babbling about?
say:8:1310917008:1.source_cn: 恶魔仪式？时间循环？你们在说什么啊，没有在开玩笑吗？

say:9:1310917009:1.text: Brother Zaneus, I saw two Hypogean altars at the other temples with my own eyes! Please let us speak with His Excellency. He needs to know what's happening.
say:9:1310917009:1.source_cn: 兹比格涅夫兄弟，我亲眼见到了两座恶魔祭坛！请让我们觐见...

say:11:1310917010:1.source_cn: 请让我们进去吧，修士先生！

say:12:1310917011:1.text: *Sigh*... I apologize. The rules of the temple are very strict. I cannot disregard the edict being enforced. Guests cannot be allowed in.
say:12:1310917011:1.source_cn: 唔……很抱歉，修道院的纪律很严格，我不能违背，因此无法...

say:13:1310917012:1.text: However, Acolyte Callahan is one of our own, so I can make an exception and allow him to meet with the Hierophant.
say:13:1310917012:1.source_cn: 但杨凯维奇兄弟是本院修士，我可以网开一面，允许他面见大...

say:15:1310917013:1.text: It's up to you, Callahan. Tell him what's happening.
say:15:1310917013:1.source_cn: 看来我们是没法进去了……杨凯维奇先生，拜托你了！

choice_prompt:16:1310917013.text: It's up to you, Callahan. Tell him what's happening.
choice_prompt:16:1310917013.source_cn: 看来我们是没法进去了……杨凯维奇先生，拜托你了！

say:17:1310917014:1.text: Rest assured. I will report everything that happened in full to His Excellency.
say:17:1310917014:1.source_cn: 各位放心，我会将之前的事情完完整整地向大主教阁下汇报的。

narration:19:1310917015:1.text: The two acolytes enter the temple together, and the heavy doors of the temple are closed.

say:21:1310917016:1.text: What course lies before us now?

say:22:1310917017:1.text: I think we should go to Cedartown again.
say:22:1310917017:1.source_cn: 我觉得……我们应该再去雪松镇看看！

say:23:1310917018:1.text: If the previous two rituals were really related to the time loop and we destroyed the altars, Cedartown should return to normal. That's my hypothesis.
say:23:1310917018:1.source_cn: 如果之前的两个邪恶仪式真的和时间循环有关，我们破坏了仪...

say:24:1310917019:1.text: Hammie's usually right. Let's go check it out.
say:24:1310917019:1.source_cn: 说得有道理！那我们现在就去吧！

choice:16:0:1.text: We'll leave the Hierophant to you.
choice:16:0:1.source_cn: 事态严重，请一定告知大主教
choice:16:0:1.male: We'll leave the Hierophant to you.
choice:16:0:1.female: We'll leave the Hierophant to you.

say:0:1310921001:0.text: Hey, there are a lot more snowmen over there...
say:0:1310921001:0.source_cn: 咦，那边也多了好多雪人啊……

say:1:1310922001:1.text: Of course, we have to go to the festival first. We still have to prepare food and equipment for the adventure. And it's best to make plans before going into the swamps...
say:1:1310922001:1.source_cn: 当然是先去祭典，我们还得准备探险时的食物和工具呢，而且...

say:2:1310922002:1.text: True, these tales of the lost have been going around for years. They can wait until we're done with the festival.
say:2:1310922002:1.source_cn: 的确，迷路怪谈持续了那么多年了，祭典结束再去也一样。<...

say:5:1310922004:1.text: Hey, I finally found you! Where did you go? You promised to join me in the festivities.
say:5:1310922004:1.source_cn: 嗨——你们，总算找到你们了！你们跑到哪里去了？说好要跟...

say:6:1310922005:1.text: Princess! So you were here... Are you alright?
say:6:1310922005:1.source_cn: 公主殿下！你在这里啊……你还好吗？

say:7:1310922006:1.text: Me? Yes, I'm fine. You're the ones who went and disappeared on me!
say:7:1310922006:1.source_cn: 我？你在说什么呢，我很好呀！倒是你们不知道跑哪去了，都...

say:9:1310922007:1.text: Princess! Ah, and new friends, nice to meet you! I'm Kristof.
say:9:1310922007:1.source_cn: 公主殿下！还有这几位朋友，初次见面，你好，我叫克什托夫。

choice_prompt:10:1310922007.text: Princess! Ah, and new friends, nice to meet you! I'm Kristof.
choice_prompt:10:1310922007.source_cn: 公主殿下！还有这几位朋友，初次见面，你好，我叫克什托夫。

say:12:1310922011:1.text: Uh... I don't think so. It's always just the two of us.
say:12:1310922011:1.source_cn: 呃……好像没有吧？一直就只有我们两个啊。

say:13:1310922012:1.text: Anyway, let's go to the festival first! Oh, how about we have a snowball fight?
say:13:1310922012:1.source_cn: 别想那么多了，咱们先去参加祭典吧！嗯，先去打雪仗怎么样？

say:14:1310922013:1.text: Snowball fight? Oh, let's all join in and see who's the best.
say:14:1310922013:1.source_cn: 打雪仗？不如我们一起吧，我们来比赛看谁更厉害！

say:15:1310922014:1.text: You only have two people. We have four. How about I join your team? Then, it'll be fair.
say:15:1310922014:1.source_cn: 我们双方……啊，你们有两个人，我们有四个人。我和你们一...

say:17:1310922015:1.text: Your Highness, where is Sir Rodrigo?
say:17:1310922015:1.source_cn: 公主殿下，罗德里戈先生呢？

say:18:1310922016:1.text: Rodrigo? He... Oh, yes... I asked him to go back the castle to retrieve my gown.
say:18:1310922016:1.source_cn: 罗德里戈？他……哦，对了……我让他先回城堡为我去取舞会...

say:19:1310922017:1.text: Don't worry about him. He isn't here, so let's try and have some fun!
say:19:1310922017:1.source_cn: 哎呀，别管他了，他不在，我们正好先玩个痛快！

say:20:1310922018:1.source_cn: 奇怪……好像又变得有点不一样了……

choice:10:0:1.source_cn: 你们是不是少了两个人？

say:22:1310922008:1.text: Uh... Should I know you? I can't recall... Livia, have we met them before?
say:22:1310922008:1.source_cn: 啊？我应该认识你们吗？不对啊……薇丝莎娃，你见过他们吗？

say:23:1310922009:1.text: No, you must've mistaken us for some other people.
say:23:1310922009:1.source_cn: 没有……你们一定是认错人了。

choice_prompt:24:1310922009.text: No, you must've mistaken us for some other people.
choice_prompt:24:1310922009.source_cn: 没有……你们一定是认错人了。

choice:24:0:1.text: You seem to be missing two people.
choice:24:0:1.male: You seem to be missing two people.
choice:24:0:1.female: You seem to be missing two people.

say:1:1310923001:1.text: I need to be confident... I can do this. I know I can.
say:1:1310923001:1.source_cn: 要有信心，要有信心……我能做到的，一定能的！<key:...

say:2:1310923002:1.text: Mister, are you still trying to propose?

say:3:1310923003:1.text: Yes, um... what do you mean "still"?

say:4:1310923004:1.text: Is Miss Kaya your girlfriend? Hmm... where is she?
say:4:1310923004:1.source_cn: 那位卡娅女士是你的……咦，卡娅女士呢？

say:5:1310923005:1.text: Shhhh! Quiet down! Don't let Kaya hear you...
say:5:1310923005:1.source_cn: 嘘，小声点！别让卡娅听见……<key:dialog1>

say:6:1310923006:1.text: If I could skate around and make a beautiful heart on the ice and then get down on one knee in front of the cheering crowd...
say:6:1310923006:1.source_cn: 要是我能在冰面上滑出一个漂亮的的心型，最后在人群的欢呼...

say:7:1310923007:1.text: Dura above, how romantic would that be? She'll definitely say yes to that!
say:7:1310923007:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上，太浪漫了，她一定会非常高兴的！<key:di...

say:8:1310923008:1.text: This is once in a lifetime! Oh, my heart is about to jump out of my chest. I need to be alone and calm down...
say:8:1310923008:1.source_cn: 这可是我的人生大事！哦，神啊，我的心脏都快要跳出来了，...

say:1:1310924002:0.text: ... There's a new snowman over there!

say:1:1310925001:1.text: There's still a time loop here. Only this time, Cedartown is getting weirder and weirder...
say:1:1310925001:1.source_cn: 时间循环并没有解除，而且雪松镇变得越来越奇怪了……

choice_prompt:2:1310925001.text: There's still a time loop here. Only this time, Cedartown is getting weirder and weirder...
choice_prompt:2:1310925001.source_cn: 时间循环并没有解除，而且雪松镇变得越来越奇怪了……

say:3:1310925002:1.text: While I haven't partaken in the other events, it is clear that the town is less crowded than it was during the ball.
say:3:1310925002:1.source_cn: 我没有参加过其他项目，但镇上的人确实比舞会的时候少了很多。

say:4:1310925003:1.text: And there are more snowmen than before...
say:4:1310925003:1.source_cn: 倒是多出来了许多奇奇怪怪的雪人……

say:5:1310925007:1.text: Time is still on repeat, and the festivities continue, but the townspeople have dwindled, and the snowmen have multiplied...
say:5:1310925007:1.source_cn: 这么说，时间还在循环，祭典还在继续，可镇子人变少了，却...

say:6:1310925008:1.text: Yes, there were some new snowmen last time we discovered the time loop. This time there are even more.
say:6:1310925008:1.source_cn: 没错，我们上次发现时间循环的时候，已经有一些新的雪人了...

say:7:1310925009:1.text: A dark thought crosses my mind. Could it be...
say:7:1310925009:1.source_cn: 我有一个不祥的想法，难道……

choice_prompt:8:1310925009.text: A dark thought crosses my mind. Could it be...
choice_prompt:8:1310925009.source_cn: 我有一个不祥的想法，难道……

say:9:1310925010:1.source_cn: 什么？！这……好像确实是这样……

say:10:1310925011:1.text: And as the time loop continues, there seems to be more and more snowmen.
say:10:1310925011:1.source_cn: 而且随着循环时间增加，雪人还变多了！

say:11:1310925013:1.text: That's horrible! Can they change back?
say:11:1310925013:1.source_cn: 这……这太可怕了！他们……他们还能变回来吗？

say:12:1310925014:1.text: If our suspicions are indeed correct, Cedartown must be entangled in a peculiar plot. It may be connected to the Hypogeans...
say:12:1310925014:1.source_cn: 如果真的是我们推测的情况，雪松镇一定陷入了一场非常诡异...

say:13:1310925015:1.text: It's imperative that we promptly decide on a course of action and communicate this matter to the authorities of Whiteridge.
say:13:1310925015:1.source_cn: 我们得尽快找到解决办法，而且必须将这件事通报给白山公国...

choice_prompt:14:1310925015.text: It's imperative that we promptly decide on a course of action and communicate this matter to the authorities of Whiteridge.
choice_prompt:14:1310925015.source_cn: 我们得尽快找到解决办法，而且必须将这件事通报给白山公国的阁下们。

say:15:1310925018:1.text: The acolyte should've already reported the evil rituals to the Hierophant. Let's <style="highlight">go to the temple</style> to see what's being done about the situation.
say:15:1310925018:1.source_cn: 那位修士应该已经把邪恶仪式的事情汇报给大主教阁下了，我...

say:16:1310925019:1.text: If the Hierophant confirms the Hypogean rituals, the Archduke will take the matter more seriously.
say:16:1310925019:1.source_cn: 要是有大主教对于恶魔仪式的证词，大公阁下应该也会更重视...

choice:14:0:1.text: We need to inform the Hierophant.
choice:14:0:1.male: We need to inform the Hierophant.
choice:14:0:1.female: We need to inform the Hierophant.

say:18:1310925016:1.text: But the Archduke doesn't seem to be in Cedartown. Should we go to the castle and find him? Or did he turn into a snowman too...?
say:18:1310925016:1.source_cn: 可大公似乎没在雪松镇，难道要去城堡里找他吗？或者……他...

say:19:1310925017:1.text: That's difficult to ascertain at the moment. Even if the Archduke avoided becoming a snowman, gaining entry into his castle may prove difficult.
say:19:1310925017:1.source_cn: 现在一切都很难讲，即使大公没有变成雪人，恐怕我们也很难...

choice:14:1:2.text: We need to inform the Archduke.
choice:14:1:2.male: We need to inform the Archduke.
choice:14:1:2.female: We need to inform the Archduke.

say:20:1310925012:1.text: Magister, do you mean people will turn into snowmen?!
say:20:1310925012:1.source_cn: 啊？！主人的意思是……人都变成雪人了？
say:20:1310925012:1.male: Magister, do you mean people will turn into snowmen?!
say:20:1310925012:1.female: Magister, do you mean people will turn into snowmen?!

choice:8:1:2.source_cn: 循环越久，人会越来越少……

say:21:1310925004:1.text: Those two wanted to go on an adventure, but they didn't even remember their friends, even though there were four of them at the beginning.
say:21:1310925004:1.source_cn: 那两个想去探险的年轻人都不记得自己的同伴了，明明最开始...

say:22:1310925005:1.text: And the man who wanted to propose didn't even notice that his fiancee was missing. Was he going to propose to a snowman or something?
say:22:1310925005:1.source_cn: 还有那个求婚的人根本没注意到他的未婚妻不见了，难道他想...

say:23:1310925006:1.text: Yes, a lot more... It's almost like everyone put their own clothes on the snowmen...
say:23:1310925006:1.source_cn: 对啊，各式各样的雪人，就像大家把自己的衣服给雪人穿上了...

say:0:1310926001:0.text: Let's go back to the temple immediately!

say:1:1310926002:0.text: Time is of the essence. I hope we can talk directly to the Hierophant this time.
say:1:1310926002:0.source_cn: 事关重大，希望这次能见到大主教。

say:4:1310906001:1.text: There's a Hypogean ritual here as well!
say:4:1310906001:1.source_cn: 这里竟然也进行过恶魔献祭的仪式！

say:5:1310906002:1.text: Fate is ever brimming with ill intent... Let us destroy the altar as before.
say:5:1310906002:1.source_cn: 果然，命运总是充满恶意……先按照之前的方式破坏祭坛吧。

say:6:1310906003:0.text: Yes! <style="highlight">Let's end that special Hypofiend and destroy the magic circle</style>!

narration:8:13010913:0.text: The acolytes at St. Valesa's Temple have turned into Hypofiends under the influence of the altar.
narration:8:13010913:0.source_cn: 在献祭祭坛的影响下，圣瓦勒沙教堂的修士们也变成了魔物。

say:4:1310907001:1.text: Goddess above! Let your wrath cleanse this world of evil!
say:4:1310907001:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上，邪恶必被您的怒火灼烧殆尽！

say:5:1310907002:1.text: From what we read earlier, this "cycle"... Could it mean the time loop in Cedartown? Could the ritual be related to it?
say:5:1310907002:1.source_cn: 那封信提到了“循环”……雪松镇的时间循环会不会和这个邪...

say:6:1310907003:1.text: "Final sacrifice"... "Awaken"... What do they seek to do?
say:6:1310907003:1.source_cn: “最终献祭”、“唤醒”……他们到底想干什么？

say:7:1310907004:1.text: I need your help... Please accompany me to Whiteridge Temple. I must meet the Hierophant. He needs to know what happened here.

say:8:1310907005:1.text: Two holy temples have fallen into darkness. All of this happened right within the vicinity of Whiteridge Temple and at this joyous time of celebration as well.
say:8:1310907005:1.source_cn: 两座本来沐浴圣光的教堂暗堕了，就在祭典这神圣快乐的时刻...

say:9:1310907006:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上……咳咳，这绝不可以！

say:10:1310907007:1.text: Are you alright, Callahan? You look pale all of a sudden.
say:10:1310907007:1.source_cn: 杨凯维奇先生，你还好吗？你的脸色看上去很苍白……

say:11:1310907008:1.text: No, I'm fine. I've been on the road for too long and now to encounter something like this... I am a little tired, both physically and mentally.
say:11:1310907008:1.source_cn: 不，不要紧。我只是跑了太久，又遇到这样的事……呼，身体...

say:12:1310907009:1.text: But no matter how tired I am, I must go meet with His Excellency. As an acolyte of the faith, I must do my duty. Only the Hierophant can stop this!
say:12:1310907009:1.source_cn: 但……就算再累，我也一定要去修道院觐见大主教阁下，这是...

say:14:1310907010:1.text: But isn't the Hierophant ill? He didn't even attend the ceremony earlier. He probably hasn't recovered yet.
say:14:1310907010:1.source_cn: 可是，那位大主教不是生病了吗？他连祭典都没有出席，恐怕...

say:15:1310907011:1.text: The Hierophant is ill? I didn't know about this. May Dura bless him.
say:15:1310907011:1.source_cn: 大主教阁下病了？我……我还不知道这件事，艾雅保佑他。

say:16:1310907012:1.text: However, even if he is ill, the Hierophant needs to be informed of this. What is happening here is blasphemy against our faith and our goddess! This cannot be tolerated!
say:16:1310907012:1.source_cn: 不过，即使大主教尚在病中，也需要让他知道这件事。这里发...

say:17:1310907013:1.text: Even if His Excellency cannot purify the evil himself, he can report the matter to the central temple authority, and they can send an exorciser.
say:17:1310907013:1.source_cn: 即便大主教阁下无法亲自净化邪恶，也可以用最快的方式将此...

say:18:1310907014:1.text: Should the architect of these events be a Hypogean, even the Hierophant shall not suffice to stop it. It may require the hand of a god to intervene...
say:18:1310907014:1.source_cn: 如果幕后黑手真的是恶魔，即使是大主教也没法阻止，或许只...

say:19:1310907015:1.text: However, you are correct. His Excellency must be informed of what has occurred as soon as possible.
say:19:1310907015:1.source_cn: 但你说得对，他至少要知道。

say:21:1310907016:1.text: Come on then, we'll escort you to Whiteridge Temple to find the Hierophant!
say:21:1310907016:1.source_cn: 走吧，我们陪你去白山修道院找大主教！

narration:23:13010917:0.text: Once again, you destroy the magic circle on the ground, demolishing the altar.
narration:23:13010917:0.source_cn: 你又一次破坏了地上的魔法阵，捣毁了这里的献祭祭坛。

say:4:1310918001:0.text: It seems that all the festival attendants have disappeared... Did the time loop stop?
say:4:1310918001:0.source_cn: 咦，祭典办事员好像都不见了……难道时间循环已经结束了？

say:6:1310918003:0.text: Chippy also feels like something is wrong...
say:6:1310918003:0.source_cn: 满满也觉得哪里怪怪的……

say:7:1310918004:0.text: Look, there are so many snowmen here now.
say:7:1310918004:0.source_cn: 对哦！这里多了好多雪人！

narration:9:13010931:0.text: After returning to Cedartown, you find the atmosphere here a little strange. The residents are nowhere to be found, and there are many snowmen on the streets.
narration:9:13010931:0.source_cn: 回到雪松镇后，你们发觉这里的气氛有些古怪，居民不知到哪...

say:4:1310919001:0.text: Magister, look at this snowman. Does it look familiar somehow...?
say:4:1310919001:0.source_cn: 主人，你看这个雪人的装饰，满满觉得好眼熟，唔，让我想想……
say:4:1310919001:0.male: Magister, look at this snowman. Does it look familiar somehow...?
say:4:1310919001:0.female: Magister, look at this snowman. Does it look familiar somehow...?

say:8:1310919002:0.text: Are you hamsters? I've never seen such teeny-tiny, squishy cuties before!
say:8:1310919002:0.source_cn: 你们是仓鼠吗？我还从来没见过你们这么可爱的种族！

say:9:1310919003:0.text: Whoa, it's the princess! You're super duper pretty!
say:9:1310919003:0.source_cn: 哇，是公主小姐姐！公主小姐姐好漂亮！<key:dial...

say:10:1310919004:0.text: Oh... Princess Your Highness, you're really really pretty! Wanna build a snowman with me?
say:10:1310919004:0.source_cn: 那……公主小姐姐殿下好漂亮哦！你们要不要和我一起堆雪人...

say:11:1310919005:0.text: Yay! Let's build the biggest snowmen ever!
say:11:1310919005:0.source_cn: 太好了，咱们一起堆几个又大又好看的雪人！<key:di...

say:17:1310919008:0.text: Wow, this snowman is so lifelike. Even its expression is so similar.
say:17:1310919008:0.source_cn: 哇，这个雪人简直是惟妙惟肖，连表情都堆得这么像。

say:18:1310919009:0.text: Hey, where did the princess go? Shouldn't she be waiting here for us to build a snowman?
say:18:1310919009:0.source_cn: 咦，公主殿下跑到哪里去了？她不是应该在这里等我们堆雪人吗？

say:19:1310919010:0.text: Maybe she went somewhere else... Don't worry though. She has that big knight as her bodyguard. Nothing will happen to her.
say:19:1310919010:0.source_cn: 也许她去了其他的地方……别担心，她身边有那位又高又大的...

choice:16:0:1.text: The snowman looks like that kid...
choice:16:0:1.source_cn: 雪人很像那个戴熊头帽的小孩子
choice:16:0:1.male: The snowman looks like that kid...
choice:16:0:1.female: The snowman looks like that kid...

say:21:1310919007:0.text: No, this is the child who built the snowmen with us!
say:21:1310919007:0.source_cn: 不对不对，这是那个和我们一起堆雪人的孩子！

choice:16:1:2.text: Is this the snowman we made?
choice:16:1:2.male: Is this the snowman we made?
choice:16:1:2.female: Is this the snowman we made?

narration:22:13010932:0.text: You return to Cedartown and find that there is a snowman wearing a bear hat at the activity site.
narration:22:13010932:0.source_cn: 你们回到雪松镇，发现在堆雪人项目的地方多出了一个带着小...

say:4:1310920001:0.text: Magister, look over here. There are a lot more snowmen than before.
say:4:1310920001:0.source_cn: 主人，你看这个，这里也多了好多的雪人。
say:4:1310920001:0.male: Magister, look over here. There are a lot more snowmen than before.
say:4:1310920001:0.female: Magister, look over here. There are a lot more snowmen than before.

say:5:1310920002:0.text: But where did the people who built these snowmen go?
say:5:1310920002:0.source_cn: 可是……那些堆雪人的人呢？人都去哪儿了？

say:6:1310920003:0.source_cn: 难道他们都有事离开了镇子？

narration:8:13010933:0.text: You explore Cedartown and find that there are many more snowmen in the town than before.
narration:8:13010933:0.source_cn: 你们在雪松镇中探查，发现镇子里的雪人比之前又多了许多。
